fullSynopsis: During a playdate, Daniel has an allergic reaction to something he ate. Mom and Dad Tiger explain that Daniel has a food allergy and teach him how to be careful about what he eats. Daniel learns that having an allergy means he needs to be extra careful, but he can still have fun and enjoy many foods safely.

title: Daniel Goes to the Dentist
shortDescription: Daniel visits the dentist for the first time and learns about taking care of his teeth.
fullSynopsis: Daniel is nervous about his first visit to the dentist, but Mom Tiger helps him understand what to expect. At the dentist's office, Daniel meets Dr. Plat who shows him how to brush properly and explains why taking care of teeth is important. Daniel discovers that the dentist visit wasn't scary after all.

title: Daniel's Big Kid Bike
shortDescription: Daniel gets a new bigger bike but struggles to learn how to ride it without training wheels.
fullSynopsis: Daniel is excited to get a new bigger bike, but when Dad Tiger suggests removing the training wheels, Daniel feels scared and frustrated. He tries to ride without them but keeps falling. With patience and practice, and encouragement from his family, Daniel learns that it takes time to learn new skills and that it's okay to keep trying until you succeed.

title: Daniel's Substitute Teacher / Daniel Plays School
shortDescription: Daniel learns to adjust when Teacher Harriet has a substitute, then plays school at home.
fullSynopsis: When Teacher Harriet is sick, Daniel and his classmates meet their substitute teacher and learn that trying new things can be fun. Daniel feels nervous at first but discovers that Miss Elaina makes learning exciting in her own special way. Later, Daniel plays school at home with Mom Tiger and Baby Margaret, taking on the role of teacher himself. He learns that being flexible and open to new experiences helps make any situation enjoyable.

title: Daniel's Winter Adventure / Daniel's Snowy Day
shortDescription: Daniel enjoys winter activities and learns to stay warm and safe in the snow.
fullSynopsis: Daniel and his friends go on a winter adventure to the Enchanted Garden, where they learn about staying warm and playing safely in the snow. They build snow sculptures and have fun while learning winter safety rules. Back at home, Daniel continues his snowy day fun with Dad Tiger, making snow angels and drinking hot cocoa. The family works together to clear their walkway and help their neighbors during the snowy weather.

title: Daniel's Babysitter / Daniel's Helpful Day
shortDescription: Daniel spends time with a babysitter and then has a day focused on helping others.
fullSynopsis: When Mom and Dad Tiger go out for the evening, Daniel stays with his babysitter, Prince Tuesday, and learns that babysitters can be fun and caring. At first Daniel misses his parents, but he discovers that Prince Tuesday has planned special activities for them to enjoy together. The next day, Daniel focuses on being helpful around the neighborhood, assisting various community members with their tasks. He learns that helping others makes him feel good and strengthens community bonds.

title: Daniel's Dance Party / Daniel's Musical Day
shortDescription: Daniel enjoys dancing and music with friends and family throughout his day.
fullSynopsis: Daniel and his friends have a dance party at school where they learn different types of dances and express themselves through movement. Music Teacher Celeste teaches them that dancing is a wonderful way to show feelings and have fun with friends. Later, Daniel continues his musical day at home, making music with household items and singing songs with his family. The day is filled with rhythm, melody, and the joy that music brings to everyday activities.

title: Daniel Tries a New Food / Daniel's Picnic
shortDescription: Daniel learns about trying new foods and then enjoys a family picnic.
fullSynopsis: At lunch time, Daniel encounters a new food that he's never tried before and feels hesitant about tasting it. With encouragement from Teacher Harriet and his friends, Daniel learns that trying new foods can be an adventure and might lead to discovering something delicious. Later, the Tiger family goes on a picnic where Daniel gets to enjoy both familiar and new foods in a fun outdoor setting. The picnic becomes a special time for family bonding and appreciating nature together.

title: Daniel's Project / Daniel's Art Show
shortDescription: Daniel works on a special project and then participates in an art show.
fullSynopsis: Daniel begins working on a special project for school and learns about patience and persistence when things don't go as planned initially. With help from Teacher Harriet, he discovers that mistakes are part of learning and that keeping trying leads to success. The project becomes part of the school's art show, where Daniel and his classmates display their creative work for families and friends. Daniel feels proud of his accomplishment and enjoys seeing everyone's unique artistic expressions.
